victim_age.reason: No age of the deceased appears in the judgment.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Husband is spouse; mother-in-law and father-in-law are relatives by marriage.

offence_category.reason: Offence is dowry death under s.304-B with s.498-A cruelty.

statutory_provisions.reason: Charges and convictions were under IPC ss.304-B and 498-A.

weapon.quote: seized the saree that had been used for hanging

evidence_type.reason: Medical and circumstantial evidence fit, but no eyewitness saw the hanging; witnesses spoke to harassment.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Persistent dowry demands, beating and abuse are stated in the judgment.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Court considered the accused's age and long period already in jail.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted all three and sentenced them to life imprisonment.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court acquitted father-in-law and confirmed the other two convictions.

final_outcome.reason: Appellants remained convicted; only the sentence was reduced.

offence_finally_established.reason: Convictions under s.304-B (dowry death) and s.498-A (cruelty) were upheld.

imprisonment_type.reason: Ten years rigorous imprisonment is a fixed-term sentence.

imprisonment_years.reason: Supreme Court awarded ten years rigorous imprisonment.

fine_rs.correct_value: Rs. 1,000 each (Rs. 3,000 total) imposed by trial court under s.498-A; not addressed by Supreme Court
fine_rs.quote: pay a fine of Rs. 1,000/- each (total fine amount Rs. 3,000/-)
fine_rs.reason: Trial court imposed a fine, so null omits it, though the Supreme Court did not address it.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Husband, father-in-law and mother-in-law were all charged; the facts otherwise match the judgment

neutral_facts.reason: Summary says only husband and mother-in-law were charged, omitting the father-in-law who was also charged.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment states life imprisonment at trial and ten years RI on appeal.

attempt_completion.reason: The deceased died by hanging, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.reason: Ligature mark and chin abrasion were found; cause of death was asphyxia from hanging.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Two offences charged (ss.304-B and 498-A IPC); convictions upheld for two accused

financial_property_loss.reason: No property loss from the offence is stated; dowry demands are the motive, not a loss.

premeditation_planning.reason: No premeditation or planning is stated.

motive.reason: Non-payment of balance dowry is the stated motive.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court accepted evidence of dowry demands, harassment and cruelty leading to suicide.

witness_credibility.reason: Court relied on LW-1's statement, corroborated by LW-3 and LW-7, as reliable and cogent.

custody_duration.reason: Arrest date is stated; exact custody duration is not given, only 'a considerable period'.

trial_duration.reason: All listed dates match: offence 15 Feb 2003, trial 4 Oct 2004, HC 26 Oct 2006, SC 16 Aug 2012.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the judgment's appearance listing.

investigation_status.reason: FIR under ss.304-B and 498-A, investigation, post-mortem and arrest on 16 Feb 2003 are stated.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is noted in the judgment.

appeal_history.reason: Trial, High Court and Supreme Court outcomes match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.reason: Matches the prosecution case of harassment by husband and in-laws over balance dowry.

defence_argument.correct_value: Appellants argued for a lenient sentence given age, attendant circumstances and time already in jail

defence_argument.reason: Recorded defence argument concerns sentence, not presumption of guilt or causation; those claims lack support.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Court applied the deeming fiction shifting onus and required a nexus between death and dowry cruelty.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Biswajit Halder and Ashok Kumar are the cases the court relied on.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Reduction based on evidence, attendant circumstances, age and time in jail matches the judgment.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Court weighed attendant circumstances, age and prolonged jail term.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court did not identify separate aggravating factors for sentencing.
